name: nexora-monorepo
description: Nexora Enterprise ERP — web and desktop shells over shared @pepbits packages.

scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify
scripts.dev:all: node ../dummy-api/server.mjs & API=$!; trap 'kill $API 2>/dev/null' EXIT INT TERM; turbo run dev
scripts.dev:stack: node ../dummy-api/server.mjs & API=$!; trap 'kill $API 2>/dev/null' EXIT INT TERM; npm run dev -w web
scripts.stop: for p in 3100 3101 3200; do lsof -ti tcp:$p | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; done; true
scripts.verify: npm run -s verify:parity && npm run -s verify:ai-gates && npm run -s verify:ai-modes && npm run -s verify:ai-context && npm run -s verify:ai-limits && npm run -s verify:em-levels
